title: Fake-DOM: grow the shared fake with browser-faithful className and id reflection
description:
Plan piece 6, step A. It must be green on its own before the FakeElement family moves.

In `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js`, add `className` and `id` as browser-faithful properties. Reading and writing them reflects the `class`/`id` attributes. After an assignment they agree with `classList` and with `.class`/`#id` selectors, and they appear in the serialized markup.

* **Tests in** `fake-dom.test.js`**.** No test may pass on a fake that did nothing. Assigning `className` changes `querySelector('.x')` results and `outerHTML`. `classList.add` shows up in `className`. After `el.id = 'a'`, the element is found by `#a`.
* **Header.** Say that this reverses one of LIN-4252's deliberate "not modelled" lines, and remove `id`/`className` from the "Deliberately not modelled" list.
* This piece touches only the fake and its tests, so it can land in parallel with the prompt-section moves once the census is in.

**Done when:** the new tests are green, each one shown red against the fake without the change, and the header is current.

---

**Where the scope and design live.** Parent: LIN-4255. Read its description's **Implementation Plan** (the approved plan) and the Plan Review Verdict comment `98a20bc0-f43b-406c-bb64-8ce22860b08f`, which has notes for the builder. The parent's approved plan is where this piece starts. Follow it. Where the code shows the plan is wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4255.

* Session fit: fits one session
* Plan-review due: no. Covered by LIN-4255's approving plan-review (comment 98a20bc0-f43b-406c-bb64-8ce22860b08f, rev 1).
* Grounding commit: `b5391736` (LinearViewer origin/main; still HEAD when this breakdown was made on 2026-11-05).

**Rules for every move piece (from the plan):** test names and counts stay the same. Before and after, run `node --test --test-reporter=spec <file>` and paste the empty diff. Remove each moved file from `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` and from the `fake-dom.js` header's consumer list in the same PR. Delete both copies, the container and the `vm` sandbox. Never loosen an assertion that reads fake internals: map it to a real-DOM replacement and prove the replacement goes red under the mutation it guards. Every red is a finding, and the PR records it as fixed, filed or fake artefact. Serializer differences (`disabled=""`, escaping) are fixed in the test's regexes, never by relaxing the fake. Out of scope: the 7 `container.querySelector ? … : null` guards in `public/prompt-section.js`.

---

## Implemented (close-out)

Implemented as approved, no deviations: `className`/`id` accessors backed only by the `class`/`id` attributes on `FakeElement`, header updated (reverses LIN-4252 "not modelled" for these two), 7 new tests in `fake-dom.test.js`. PR: [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2298](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2298>), merged as `6d287518`. This description held no embedded plan/research sections to prune (the approved plan lives on LIN-4255); full pre-close history is in the task snapshots and comment trail.

comments.body:
**LIN-4270 ready for review:** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2298 (head `1a918892`, base `main`). Not merged; not Done.

**What changed:** `FakeElement` in `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js` gets `className` and `id` accessors backed only by the `class`/`id` attributes. `className = ''` leaves `class=""`. The header drops both from "not modelled" and records the reversal of LIN-4252's choice. Seven new tests in `fake-dom.test.js`.

**Red (unchanged fake):** 51 tests, 44 pass, 7 fail, each on its intended assertion. One of the seven was a bug in my test (a detached element queried by `#z`), corrected inside the branch and disclosed in the PR.

**Green:** `fake-dom.test.js` 51/51. The 13 consumer suites match baseline in names and counts. Full `npm run test:unit`: 23,596 pass, 0 fail.

**Existing names:** the 44 pre-existing test names and statuses are identical to `6ff38cf5` (empty diff). No removed lines.

**Mutation check:** with the setters writing expandos, 5 of the 7 new tests go red. The other 2 do not call the setters, so they stay green by design. Restored and verified byte-identical.

**Census:** nothing moved, so `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` (56) and the consumer list are unchanged.

**CI (Tests workflow, run 42037341083):** Unit tests pass (9m21s); E2E shards 1/4, 2/4, 3/4, 4/4 pass; Secret scan pass; CI success pass.

**For review, look at:**
- the accessors in `fake-dom.js` (the only implementation change);
- the header wording and reversal note;
- the seven new tests, checking each red reason rather than only the green status.

Finding (no consumer went red): `public/question-cards.js` assigns `.className` about 15 times. Those writes now reach the markup, and `lin-4242-waiting-merge` and `lin-4246` still pass.

Out of scope: the 7 `container.querySelector ? … : null` guards in `public/prompt-section.js`.

## Review — LIN-4270

Reviewed PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2298 at head `1a918892` (base `main` at `6ff38cf5`, which is still origin/main, so the branch is current).

CI: green on `1a918892`. Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan and CI success all pass. I also re-ran it locally: `npm run test:unit` gave 23,596 pass and 0 fail.

**Scope matches the plan.** Two files changed: `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js` (+10/−2) and `tests/unit/fake-dom.test.js` (+78/−0). Nothing moved, so the census and the consumer list are correctly left alone. The prompt-section guards are untouched.

**Implementation.** `className` and `id` are accessors on `FakeElement`. Their only store is the attribute: a read is `getAttribute(...) ?? ''` and a write is `setAttribute(name, String(v))`. This matches the browser for reflected DOMString attributes. `className = ''` leaves `class=""`, a missing attribute reads as `''`, and a non-string value is stringified. Selectors (`.class` uses `classList.contains`, which reads the attribute, and `#id` uses `getAttribute('id')`) and the serializer read `_attrs`, so they follow these writes with no extra code.

**Header.** `className` and `id` are now in the Attributes bullet, with an explicit note that this reverses LIN-4252's "not modelled" choice. Both are removed from the "Deliberately not modelled" list. ✔

**Test names and counts.** I diffed spec output for `fake-dom.test.js` between `origin/main` and the head. The 44 pre-existing names and statuses are identical. The only additions are the 7 new tests and their suite. No assertion was removed or loosened.

**Red against the unchanged fake (I re-ran it).** With `fake-dom.js` restored from `origin/main`, all 7 new tests fail and the other 44 pass.

**Mutation checks (each reverted, then `cmp` against the head copy, and `git status` was clean):**
- Setters write expandos instead of the attribute: 5 of 7 fail. The other two only call `classList` or `setAttribute` and then read back, so they pass by design.
- Getters always return `''`: 3 of 7 fail (classList→className, setAttribute→className, setAttribute→id).
- The `id` getter returns `null` when absent: 1 fails (the "reads as the empty string" test).
- `className = ''` removes the attribute: 1 fails (the `class=""` test).

Every accessor line is pinned by at least one test that goes red when that line is removed or broken.

**Regression check.** `git log` on both files shows only LIN-4252 (`d234b94a`) and LIN-4265 (`69e8f175`). Neither fixed or reverted anything about className or id, and this PR re-applies nothing reverted. Nothing has landed on these paths since the ticket was created except LIN-4265, which is already in the base.

**One of a class?** The class is "fake elements without className/id reflection". The other instances are the hand-written fakes on the census list (`HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES`). They are already scoped to the sibling move tickets (LIN-4271, LIN-4269, LIN-4266), and this deliverable does not depend on them, so they are outside this piece. Within the shared fake the change is complete: `getElementById` is not modelled and was not asked for.

**Consumer impact.** `public/question-cards.js` assigns `.className` and those writes now reach the markup. The suites that consume the shared fake are inside `test:unit` and pass, so CI covers this.

### What CI Did Not Prove
CI covers the deliverable; ledger empty. This is a test-helper-only change, its own tests run in CI, and the red-on-old and mutation evidence above was re-run independently.

### Verdict
Approve. The accessors are browser-faithful and backed only by the attributes. The header is current. All 7 new tests are red on the unchanged fake and are pinned under mutation. Existing names and counts are unchanged, and CI is green on `1a918892`. Ready for close-out.

## Close-out — LIN-4270

**Merged:** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2298, squash-merged as `6d287518` on `main`, pinned with `--match-head-commit 1a918892`. Base was still `6ff38cf5` and the PR was MERGEABLE/CLEAN.

**Authority:** the review comment records an Approve with an explicitly empty ledger ("ledger empty").

**Changes I made after approval:** none. The review asked for no fixes, so the PR is exactly the reviewed head `1a918892`. No stale citations or comments turned up.

**Ledger:** empty, so nothing to settle. No outside items, so no follow-ups were filed. No existing-ticket search was needed.

**CI:** applies (GitHub Actions "Tests"). On `1a918892` Unit tests, E2E shards 1/4 to 4/4, Secret scan and CI success all passed (run 42037341083). The Tests run on the merge commit `6d287518` was queued when I last looked and I did not wait for it; the squash content is the reviewed head.

**Deploy:** none. This is a test-helper-only change, so there is no post-deploy step. I checked the merged tree at `6d287518`. `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js` has the `className` and `id` accessors (lines 233-237, attribute-backed) and the header reversal note (lines 28-30).

**Description:** archived first. The `brief?noRefresh=1` call ran and `/snapshots` shows the pre-prune description, so the archive is confirmed. The description held no embedded plan, research or scoping sections to prune (the approved plan lives on LIN-4255), so I kept it intact and appended an "Implemented" stub. The `Plan-review due` and session-fit lines are unchanged.

**Related tickets:** LIN-4271 (FakeElement family move) was blocked by this piece, and that block is now clear. I left it Todo because its own work is not done. LIN-4255 (parent) stays In Progress with its other siblings still open.

## Autopilot run summary — LIN-4270 (stepper)

**Outcome:** merged and Done. PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2298 squash-merged as `6d287518`; CI run 42039930537 on that commit is green (Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan, CI success).

**Beats run (one warm worker session):**
1. Ground and baseline — re-grounded against HEAD (found LIN-4265 header drift), baseline `fake-dom.test.js` 44/44 and 13 consumer suites recorded; flagged the `question-cards.js` `.className` writes as a risk.
2. Failing tests — 7 new tests added (`ebc66198`); on the unchanged fake 7 fail on the intended assertions, 44 existing pass.
3. Implement — `className`/`id` accessors backed by the `class`/`id` attributes, header updated (reverses the earlier "not modelled" choice) (`1a918892`); 51/51 green, all 13 consumer suites identical to baseline, mutation check red then restored. One setup fix to the worker's own new `id` test (detached element), disclosed in the PR.
4. PR, CI, Linear — PR #2298 opened, all 7 CI checks green, full unit suite 23,596 pass / 0 fail.

**Then (fresh sessions):** review approved with an empty ledger (comment `339f88e3`, four independent mutation checks each turned a new test red); close-out merged and set Done.

**What holds:** the 44 existing test names and results are unchanged; no existing assertion was touched; no file moved, so `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` and the consumer list are unchanged; the 7 `container.querySelector ? … : null` guards in `public/prompt-section.js` were left alone as out of scope.
**What's left:** nothing for this ticket. Remaining fake-dom moves are the sibling tickets (LIN-4268, 4269, 4271, 4272).
